lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Lucky Seven. 1:40 AM. The pie is the same. You are a little poorer.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: Tell me the hand that got you.

lines.name: YOU
lines.text: King-jack, early position. I raised. Got three-bet. Called. Flopped a jack. Lost everything to kings.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: Then the hand didn't get you. The first decision did. From early, king-jack is a fold. Everything after was a story you told yourself.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: Fold the junk. That's not advice, it's arithmetic. Your misses are on the Spacepad. Drill them until the fold is boring.
